author: rentreijs
quote: I’ve put about ten hours into GTA 6, and honestly, it doesn’t feel like "Grand Theft Auto" at all .. it feels like a glorified chore simulator.Instead of jumping into heists and mayhem, I spent my first several hours running errands for Lucia: buying groceries and flowers, assembling furniture, painting walls, and fixing broken stairs. Being tied at the hip to her kills the classic outlaw freedom, turning Jason into a passive errand boy who gets the silent treatment if he comes home late.Worse, the sandbox itself is handcuffed. You can’t steal every car, certain NPCs are completely invincible, and staple features like mission replay, safe houses, the stock market, and sex workers are flat out gone. Add in sluggish 30 FPS performance with dips into the mid20s, and that 99 Metacritic score feels like a total lie. Right now, the only way to have fun is to completely ignore the story.
